title: Agentic AI Reshapes Digital Economy
subtitle: Global AI advancements impact Indian tech and business
seoDescription: Weekly digest of AI agentic tech, business models, and platform updates with Indian relevance.
author: XDCoderz
closingSynthesis: The accelerating development of AI agents and new monetization models presents both challenges and opportunities for Indian businesses.

events.headline: Cars24 scales customer interactions with OpenAI agents
events.description: Indian e-commerce platform Cars24 is now handling over a million minutes of customer conversations monthly using OpenAI's voice and chat agents. This integration has helped recover 12% of lost leads and deployed agentic workflows across its teams. Cars24 uses OpenAI-powered voice and chat agents to handle 1M+ monthly conversation minutes, recover 12% of lost leads, and bring agentic workflows to teams across the company.
events.indiaRelevance: Cars24, an Indian company, demonstrates AI agent success in lead recovery and operational efficiency.
events.hitsFirst: Indian e-commerce and customer support teams

analysis.bottomLine: Companies can significantly improve customer engagement and sales conversion using specialized AI agents.

analysis.winnersAndPressure: Winners are companies adopting AI for customer interaction; pressure is on traditional call centers and lead generation firms.

events.headline: Cloudflare launches Monetization Gateway for web resource charging
events.description: Cloudflare is opening a waitlist for its Monetization Gateway, enabling businesses to charge for web pages, datasets, and APIs. Transactions will settle in stablecoins via the x402 protocol, eliminating the need for custom payment stacks. We're opening the waitlist for our Monetization Gateway, which will allow you to charge for any web page, dataset, API, or MCP tool behind Cloudflare. The charges will settle in stablecoins over the x402 open protocol, with no payments stack of your own to build.
events.indiaRelevance: Indian developers and businesses can leverage this to monetize digital assets and services globally.
events.hitsFirst: Indian SaaS providers and API-first companies

analysis.bottomLine: New tools simplify charging for digital content and services, lowering barriers to entry for creators.
analysis.commercialImpact: Potential for new revenue streams, reduced operational overhead for payment processing, and increased adoption of digital services.
analysis.winnersAndPressure: Winners include content creators and service providers; pressure on traditional payment gateways and e-commerce platforms.
analysis.watchNext: Number of businesses joining the Monetization Gateway waitlist

events.headline: GitHub Copilot code review improved by Unix-style tools
events.description: GitHub found that migrating Copilot code review to shared Unix-style tools reduced review costs. This shift reshaped agent workflows around pull request evidence, proving that simpler tools can enhance AI-assisted processes. How migrating Copilot code review to shared Unix-style code exploration tools reduced review cost by reshaping agent workflows around pull request evidence. The post Better tools made Copilot code review worse. Here’s how we actually improved it. appeared first on The GitHub Blog .

events.headline: Cloudflare launches Precursor for agentic behavior detection
events.description: Cloudflare introduced Precursor, a new engine for bot management that detects agentic behavior using continuous client-side signals. It offers enhanced visibility into human-bot interactions, improving automation detection with less friction for users. Precursor, our new continuous behavioral validation engine for bot management, offers visibility into how humans and bots actually interact across the full user journey. By turning session-level behavior into bot detection signals, it identifies advanced automation with higher precision - while reducing friction for legitimate users.
